conditions.evidence: textures similar to those of non-small cell lung cancer
conditions.label: non-small cell lung cancer

modalities.evidence: 17 CT scans of the Credence Cartridge Radiomics (CCR) phantom
two sets of contours as DICOM RT structure files

output.population: No patients; the Credence Cartridge Radiomics phantom, with 10 cartridges of differing textures, scanned 17 times at four medical centers using each center's chest protocol.
output.summary: CT scans of a texture phantom acquired at four medical centers on scanners from four manufacturers, with cartridge contours as RT structure files, letting researchers evaluate radiomic texture feature robustness across scanners.
